name: Moz Data
description:
The Moz Data MCP server exposes Moz Data API tools for SEO data: site metrics, links, keywords, rankings, and more.

For instructions on how to connect: https://moz.com/api/docs/guides/mcp-servers

_published_faq.name: How do I add Moz Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Moz Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.moz.com/mcp/v1/data. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Moz Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moz Data lists 26 MCP tools, including DataGlobalTopDomainList, DataGlobalTopPageList, DataKeywordMetricsFetch, DataKeywordSearchIntentFetch, DataKeywordSuggestionsList, DataSiteAnchorTextList, DataSiteLinkFilterAnchorText, DataSiteLinkFilterDomain, DataSiteLinkIntersectFetch, DataSiteLinkList, DataSiteLinkStatusFetch, and DataSiteLinkStatusFetchMultiple.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Moz Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Moz Data in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Moz Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moz Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Moz Data is developed by Moz. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
